# Grimmory Brand And Trademark Guidance

The Grimmory name, logos, wordmarks, and other visual brand assets in this
repository are trademarks and brand assets of Grimmory.

## What this means

- The repository code and scripts are licensed under MIT.
- The visual assets are governed by `ASSET-LICENSE.md` and this document.
- The brand assets are provided for approved use, reference, integration, press,
  and community distribution.
- This repository does not grant permission to imply endorsement, official
  partnership, or authorship by Grimmory.

## Allowed use

- Referencing Grimmory in articles, tutorials, integrations, and open source
  projects.
- Using the provided assets when linking to or describing Grimmory.
- Packaging the unmodified official assets in downstream applications that need
  to display Grimmory branding accurately.

## Not allowed without explicit permission

- Modifying the Grimmory name or logos in a way that creates a confusingly
  similar mark.
- Using the marks for a competing product or service.
- Using the marks in a way that implies endorsement, sponsorship, or an official
  business relationship when none exists.
- Recoloring, stretching, or remixing the assets outside the official variants
  published here.

## Official variants in this repository

- `bookmark-red`: red bookmark treatment
- `bookmark-white`: white bookmark treatment
- accent variants generated from the official Grimmory gradient stops

Questions or commercial brand use requests should be directed to the Grimmory
maintainers.
